author: claude
reason: plans/promotion-plan.sh v2 is written and syntax-checked, but the sandbox tests the release requires (absent-resolver positive, failure rollback, partial install failure, exact state restore, stale-pass rejection) were NOT built or run inside the 15 min bound. It must not be signed on this claim.
read_only_baseline: 20:07Z: agent-loop@campaign4.service active/enabled; agent-loop-liveness@campaign4.timer active/enabled; agent-loop-liveness@campaign4.service inactive/static; agent-loop-liveness-failed@campaign4.service inactive/static; escalation-watch.timer active/enabled; escalation-watch.service inactive/static; ~/.config/agent-deck/escalation-resolve ABSENT; unit fragment ~/.config/systemd/user/agent-loop@.service.

v2_design.guards_no_mutation: candidate/adapter hashes; the CANDIDATE binary loads the prospective config (required 0/300/600 policy is enforced by the product's own validation); no package at step decision.
v2_design.snapshot: each of binary/config/escalation-watch/escalation-resolve: present (bytes, sha256, mode) or ABSENT; each timer/service: is-active and is-enabled; the old run InvocationID.
v2_design.stop: timers first (liveness timer, watch timer), then the loop, checker, checker-failed handler and watch service, each `timeout 30 systemctl stop` (no waiting for the loop to stop itself); verified inactive.
v2_design.install: exact pins; bytes verified against pins; daemon-reload.
v2_design.start_verify: start only units the snapshot had active; a NEW run InvocationID; a ledger loop-pass by that invocation and MainPID at/after the start (P12 pass_eval: stale pass rejected); one checker run whose verdict is ok|rest at/after the start (P12 healthy_eval); installed config loads.
v2_design.restore: on any failure after the first mutation: stop units, put back present files by bytes and verify sha+mode, REMOVE files that were absent (never fabricated), daemon-reload, start units that were active; then compare every file and unit state with the snapshot -> ROLLBACK PASS or FAIL.

known_gaps: Sandbox tests not built or run (see reason).

The prospective config's db path is the production ledger, so the guard's `candidate status --config PROSPECTIVE` reads the production ledger (read-only intent; the product may take its lock briefly).
is-enabled state is captured but restore restores active state only; enablement is not changed by the plan (no enable/disable calls), so it cannot drift from the snapshot.
no_changes: No product/source/adapter/host changes; only read-only inspection.
